question: At a given commit, can a first-time technical reader reconstruct what the project is, what is authoritative, what is runnable, what is experimental, and what to do next — without hitting contradictory status, stale paths, mixed artifact roles, or avoidable noise?

result_class_definitions.PASS: The aspect executed fully and found no in-scope defect.
result_class_definitions.DEFECT: The aspect executed and established at least one in-scope defect.
result_class_definitions.INCOMPLETE: The aspect executed but its observation is incomplete or underdetermined (e.g. inventory or consumer search incomplete, or policy leaves the actionable question unresolved). Boundary: ran but could not fully conclude.
result_class_definitions.FAILED: The aspect CM could not execute a required mechanical step at all. Boundary: could not run.

inputs.name: repository_snapshot
inputs.role: the tracked tree at one exact commit (git ls-files)

inputs.name: reader_profile
inputs.role: the declared reader: technically experienced, understands software repositories, unfamiliar with TSC, no TSC vocabulary

inputs.name: live_surface_policy
inputs.role: the reader-navigable front door + everything reachable in ≤1 documented hop + the authority sources the fixture checks against

inputs.name: exclusions
inputs.role: excluded paths with reasons (.cdd .cn-sigma .cell .tsc heldout, .claude/worktrees/**, docs/{alpha,beta,gamma} except docs/beta/governance/, katas/*/input, _build)

steps.action: Manifest the live reader surface (α): commit SHA, inventory over the live-surface policy, excluded paths + reasons, reader profile, generated/frozen classification, any surface left unread. An incomplete/uninventoried surface is INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION, never 'coherent'.

Run the blind newcomer-task fixture FIRST, from README.md only: the six questions, each answered in ≤1 documented hop (no Git history, no glossary for basic identity), then verified against its authority source.
Local clarity per live document: one governing question; purpose + authority visible immediately; no stale future tense; no historical-as-current; no removable repetition.

Relational & authority atlas (β): one authoritative home per stable fact; README↔STATUS agree; portal matches the tree; every Markdown link and canonical path on the live surface resolves; implementation claims match code.

Lifecycle & lineage: distinguish current/draft/normative/experimental/generated/historical/frozen/superseded; no draft-as-normative, no historical plan as current work, no generated artifact reading as authoritative, no stale current entry point after a move.

Operability: documented commands run; targets/links/schemas resolve; rendered artifacts match sources. Where a mechanical check cannot execute in the declared environment, record a BOUNDED single-check refusal (not a whole-run incompleteness).
Continuation (γ) + emit: compare to the prior run; emit the α inventory, β atlas, findings with warrant, refusals, and the categorical status + result_class via the Result rule.

clauses.when: FAILED — derivation.execution_failed_refusals is non-empty (a required mechanical check could not run at all; a refusal of kind CM_EXECUTION_FAILED).

INCOMPLETE — derivation.inventory_incomplete_refusals is non-empty (a refusal of kind INCOMPLETE_OBSERVATION or UNDERDETERMINED whose scope is 'inventory' — the inventory could not be completed, a claimed authority is missing, or a defect could not be confirmed from evidence). A BOUNDED single-check refusal (scope not in derivation.status_flipping_refusal_scopes, i.e. 'single_check') does NOT trip this arm — it is honest incompleteness of one check that does not flip the categorical status.

DEFECT — a confirmed in-scope defect: derivation.defect_findings is non-empty, OR derivation.failed_requirement_checks is non-empty (some REPO-* check verdict is FAIL), OR derivation.failed_newcomer_questions is non-empty (some newcomer-fixture question did not PASS).

boundary.note: The CM observes, checks, and emits defects with warrant; it changes no files. Measure commit A → freeze the receipt → repair on commit B → re-run → compare A and B → an independent reviewer closes (REPO-REPAIR-001, REPO-REVIEW-001, parent RCM-BOUNDARY-001). A single invocation that edits files while observing them destroys its own evidence.

requirements.text: The front door identifies the project, the runnable surface, the active research, and the next paths — in one screen.
Every live document answers one governing question, with purpose and authority visible immediately.
Every stable fact has one authoritative home; no two documents claim incompatible authority.
Every status projection agrees with its authority source (spec version, software version, ratification, conformance standing).
Every current path and Markdown link on the live surface resolves.
Directory placement matches the declared repository-plane contract; no two documentation systems are presented as authoritative at once.
Historical, superseded, or generated artifacts cannot be read as current instructions.
Documented runnable commands execute under the declared environment.
Repetition, stale wrappers, and obsolete navigation do not obscure current project truth.
A repair run changes only findings in scope and preserves meaning (evidence-boundary rule).
A COHERENT_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE claim requires an independent full-scope review, separate from the repair actor.

questions.question: What is TSC?
questions.answer: README.md:3–5: a framework for deciding whether several observations are explained by one lawful process, returning a proof-carrying receipt (not a score). 1 hop docs/THESIS.md:3–16 confirms in plain language; no glossary needed for identity; uncontradicted.

questions.question: Which specification is authoritative?
questions.answer: 1 hop STATUS.md:3–8: 4.0.0 Normative is the last ratified / current normative warrant; 4.1.0 Draft is the in-progress spec. spec/README.md:1–8,75 agrees. Which spec is authoritative is answerable without reading the ratified 4.0.0 text (commit 4da1122).

questions.question: What can be executed today?
questions.answer: README.md:29–40 + 1 hop docs/quickstart/README.md:1–5: coh 0.12.0 repository proxy (v3.2-era), modes mechanical/llm/hybrid/auto, katas — explicitly not v4, no v4 receipt. Authority agrees.

questions.question: What does the current coh engine actually implement?
questions.answer: Front door (README.md:13,31) + 1 hop STATUS.md:20–22: the v3.2-era repository-proxy scoring/witness contract; explicitly NOT TSC v4 Core/Operational/Conformance. Deeper engine authority is 2 hops but the identity answer needs no such hop. Uncontradicted.

questions.question: What is the active research program?
questions.answer: README.md:9–16 ('Current research: Articulation Ascent') + 1 hop research/ascent/README.md:1–9; STATUS.md:51–53 names it the primary program for the current bounded sprint. Uncontradicted.

receipt.scope: Declared reader: technically experienced, understands software repositories, unfamiliar with TSC, no TSC vocabulary. Live-surface policy: the reader-navigable front door + everything reachable in ≤1 documented hop + the authority sources the fixture checks against.
